name: What is the difference between water damage restoration and mold remediation services?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between water damage restoration and mold remediation services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water damage restoration focuses on mitigating immediate water damage, drying affected areas, and restoring properties to pre-loss conditions after events like burst pipes or floods. Mold remediation, however, specifically addresses the removal and prevention of mold growth. While water damage restoration often includes steps to prevent mold, if mold has already developed, specialized mold remediation protocols are necessary to safely contain, remove, and treat affected areas, ensuring healthy indoor air quality and structural integrity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Water damage restoration dries and repairs after water incidents, while mold remediation specifically removes and prevents mold growth, often a secondary issue of water damage.
